channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran says lack of trust is the main obstacle in US negotiations
item.description: Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said that a deep mistrust with the US continues to hinder negotiations

item.title: India and UAE sign defence pacts, as Iran war tensions simmer
item.description: A deal inked during Modi's visit to the UAE focuses on maritime security, cyberdefence, and military collaboration.

item.title: Araghchi: Iran doubts US ‘seriousness’ about talks amid nuclear deadlock
item.description: Iran's FM Abbas Araghchi spoke at a BRICS meeting in India about his "distrust" of the US regarding war negotiations.

item.title: Deadly attack on Pakistan outpost puts Afghanistan ceasefire at risk
item.description: Two assaults in the northwest region have killed more than 20 people in recent days.

item.title: Why the Iran conflict is becoming a problem for BRICS
item.description: Second BRICS meeting in a row collapses without joint position because of disagreements over the war on Iran.

item.title: Prisoner swap goes ahead as Kyiv mourns 24 killed in Russian strike on flats
item.description: Among the victims in Kyiv was 12-year-old Lyubava Yakovleva, whose father was killed during the war.

item.title: New York Times defends journalist after Israel threatens to sue
item.description: Israel's prime minister says he has ordered legal action over an article which alleged Israeli security officials raped Palestinian detainees.

item.title: Why is Ireland not taking part in this year's Eurovision?
item.description: Ireland's boycott is the latest in a series of moves that has seen the country at odds with Israel over its war in Gaza.
